Enum Class RequirementCategoryEnum

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<RequirementCategoryEnum>
sysmlinjava.requirements.RequirementCategoryEnum
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<RequirementCategoryEnum>, Constable
public enum RequirementCategoryEnum extends Enum<RequirementCategoryEnum>
SysMLinJava representation of SysML's requirement categories with additional categories frequently needed for formal system requirements specifications. Limiting requirement categorization to the SysML standard should use functional, performance, interface, and design categories only, while other popular standard's based specifications may use the other categories as well.
Author:
ModelerOne
